name: development
summary: Canonical discipline for version-controlled implementation, repository inspection, tests, build and lint checks, platform development routing, code review, debugging, and evidence-backed development handoff.
blocking_rules: Do not edit a repository before identifying the target repo, reading its instructions when present, and checking the starting worktree.
Do not mutate live WordPress state, production systems, external systems, repository remotes, or deployment targets without the relevant approved workflow.
Do not invent implementation details that repository inspection, client Stack notes, approved design, or tests can determine.
Do not broaden scope through drive-by refactors, formatting sweeps, dependency upgrades, or cleanup unrelated to the request.
Do not claim completion from a process exit alone; acceptance criteria need evidence.
Do not edit tests to fake success or delete failing coverage unless explicitly in scope and reported.
Do not store or expose secrets in .agents, harness, root docs, reports, or manifests.
